description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the list of API products that can be published to a specified HiMarket developer portal. The request accepts the portal ID, API product name, and paging parameters. Each item in the response includes the API product ID, name, and description
description_zh: 分页查询可发布到指定 HiMarket 开发者门户的 API 产品列表，入参可指定门户 ID、API 产品名称与分页参数，列表项返回 API 产品 ID、API 产品名称与 API 产品描述
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-publishable-products --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --name weather-query-api --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPublishableProducts

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HiMarket developer portal. This is the primary ID of the Portal resource and specifies the portal for which to query publishable API products. This ID refers to the same object as the portalId parameter in the PublishProduct request body
parameters.help_zh: HiMarket 开发者门户 ID，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID，用于指定要查询哪个门户的可发布 API 产品；该 ID 与 PublishProduct 请求体中的 portalId 指向同一对象
parameters.name: portal_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the API product. This corresponds to the name field in the response list items
parameters.help_zh: API 产品名称，与响应列表项中的 name 为同一字段
parameters.name: name

content.description_en: The list of API products that can be published to the portal. Each element in the list is named productInfo and contains the information about an API product
content.description_zh: 可发布在该门户上的 API 产品列表，列表元素名为 productInfo，每个元素为一个 API 产品的信息

description.description_en: The description of the API product. This corresponds to the Description property of the Product resource
description.description_zh: API 产品描述，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Description 属性
description.example: 提供天气查询能力的 API 产品

name.description_en: The name of the API product. This corresponds to the Name property of the Product resource
name.description_zh: API 产品名称，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Name 属性

productId.description_en: The ID of the API product. This is the primary ID of the Product resource. You can use this ID in the PublishProduct operation at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications to publish the product to the portal. You can also use it to locate the product in operations such as GetProduct and ListProductPublications
productId.description_zh: 该 API 产品的 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID。可用于 PublishProduct 在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications 中把该产品发布到门户，也可用于 GetProduct、ListProductPublications 等接口定位该产品

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the API product. This corresponds to the name field in the response list items
v1_parameters.help_zh: API 产品名称，与响应列表项中的 name 为同一字段
v1_parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the HiMarket developer portal. This is the primary ID of the Portal resource and specifies the portal for which to query publishable API products. This ID refers to the same object as the portalId parameter in the PublishProduct request body
v1_parameters.help_zh: HiMarket 开发者门户 ID，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID，用于指定要查询哪个门户的可发布 API 产品；该 ID 与 PublishProduct 请求体中的 portalId 指向同一对象
v1_parameters.name: portalId
